# Agile Project Management & Engineering Tracking Artifacts

This directory contains the systematic Agile/Scrum project management, verification, and quality audit artifacts for the **Intelligent Bug Diagnosis Platform with Fix Recommendation Assistance** (Infosys Springboard Virtual Internship).

## Artifact Directory

1. **Sprint Planning & User Stories**:
   - [`user-stories-and-sprint-backlog.csv`](user-stories-and-sprint-backlog.csv): 16 user stories across Sprints 1 to 4 with MoSCoW prioritization, dependencies, assignees, and completion status.
   - Documentation & Scope: [`../../docs/project-management/user-stories-and-sprint-backlog.md`](../../docs/project-management/user-stories-and-sprint-backlog.md)

2. **Test Cases & Quality Assurance (QA) Execution**:
   - [`test-cases-and-results.csv`](test-cases-and-results.csv): 20 comprehensive test cases covering triage, log parsing, LangGraph orchestration, error resilience, and accuracy measurement (100% Passed).
   - Test Matrix & Verification Details: [`../../docs/project-management/test-cases-and-results.md`](../../docs/project-management/test-cases-and-results.md)

3. **Defect Tracking Log**:
   - [`defect-tracking-log.csv`](defect-tracking-log.csv): 12 development defects tracked across sprints with root-cause categorization, actions taken, and resolution verification (100% Closed).
   - Root-Cause & Audit Details: [`../../docs/project-management/defect-tracking-log.md`](../../docs/project-management/defect-tracking-log.md)
